title: Audit and rationalize Figma components: naming, variants, and auto-layout fixes
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: Perform a focused audit of the central Figma library to unify component naming, consolidate redundant variants, and fix auto-layout inconsistencies for buttons, tables, and chart frames. This ticket covers: 1) establishing a naming convention and applying it across button, table, and chart components; 2) merging near-duplicate variants into explicit variant properties (size, state, density, tone); 3) correcting auto-layout constraints so components resize predictably when used in consumer files; 4) updating token references where components still reference deprecated tokens; and 5) producing a safe publish procedure with migration notes for product teams.

Scope (in-scope): button family (primary/secondary/ghost/link), table row/cell components, small chart wrapper components (legend + tooltip), variant metadata, token substitution audit.

Out of scope: full design tokens overhaul (separate ticket), iconography redesign, component redesigns that change interaction patterns.

Success criteria / acceptance:
- All component instances in the master library use the new naming convention and have variant properties documented in the component page.
- No components with broken auto-layout when width/height is flexed; standardized padding tokens applied.
- Migration doc and a 'how-to' checklist produced and shared in Confluence and linked in this ticket.
- Publish completed with 'minor' semantic version and release notes; consumer impact communicated via Slack and weekly sync.

Notes:
- Prior audits found ~18 duplicate button components across pages and 12 table variants with mismatched row auto-layout settings.
- Engineering dependency ENG-4321 is needed to land token name aliases so visual components can point at stable token keys.

Deliverables:
- Figma library edits (components page updated)
- Migration guide (Confluence link) and Slack announcement draft
- Release notes and post-publish QA checklist

Acceptance criteria checklist (will be updated as items clear):
- [ ] Draft naming convention reviewed by design and PM
- [ ] Rename components and update variants
- [ ] Fix auto-layout for table rows and cells
- [ ] Swap deprecated tokens to aliases provided by ENG
- [ ] Internal review and stakeholder sign-off
- [ ] Publish and notify consumers
